_comment: The panel registry: which device token belongs to which room.
THE LIVE COPY OF THIS FILE DOES NOT BELONG IN THE REPO. It holds device
tokens, and a Jenkins checkout would overwrite it — this house has lost
live config that way four times. Put it at
which is what docker-compose.yml mounts read-only at /config.
The gateway re-reads it on every request, so adding a panel is editing
this file. No deploy, no restart.
`room` becomes the chat_id Alfred House sees, so it is also the name he
uses when he talks about the place. Keep them lowercase and unaccented:
Generate a token with: python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(16))"
